features: Replaces Live Screen event-card listing with a compact cascading dropdown workflow
Projection operator now selects Event, then Category/Division, then the applicable Heats, Semifinal or Final round
Only projection options applicable to the selected round appear below the selectors
Heats exposes Judges, Competitors, Scoring Status and Callback Reveal
Semifinal exposes Judges, Competitors, Scoring Status and Finalists Reveal
Final exposes Judges, Finalists/Couples, Scoring Status, Final Ranking and Winner Reveal
Screen & Layout Settings opens for the exact selected round
Mirrors the same cascading selector workflow into Scoring Tests
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
